description: This file defines the SugarFieldImage class, a custom field for handling image uploads within the SuiteCRM platform. It extends the SugarFieldFile class and includes methods for rendering in list views, saving uploaded images, verifying image validity, and managing associated metadata.

classes.name: SugarFieldImage
classes.description: A class extending SugarFieldFile to handle image-specific upload and display logic in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getListViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares data for displaying the image field in list views, assigning the module context.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the saving of uploaded images, including validation, file movement, and metadata association.

methods.name: verify_image
methods.description: Validates whether the uploaded file is a valid image.

methods.name: fillInOptions
methods.description: Sets default options and overrides for field display and upload behavior.
